seed: Make Vixen Cybernetics' fully reimagined, extensible mathematical OBSERVATORY the primary apex-quality, interactive research theater, with the Synthesis Salon subsidiary and unrestricted creative re-engineering of Vixen's visual architecture, including its background, frontispiece, lighting and staging whenever mathematically or artistically warranted. Material synthesis: cold gunmetal, liquid platinum/mirror chrome, UV-violet and electric arc flash accents under restrained Glinda pink, not Easter candy. The source-regulated scenery requires real WebGL2/Canvas2D hybrid visualization of Loom's exactly 39 classified carriers (6/13/20), actual Dome-Art mathematical moiré/phi/gradient samplers, Refractive Couture [111] depth/nullspace, and Aperture v3.2 typed observation ranks. Connect effects causally to the an open, expandable collection of scientifically typed Observatory laboratories (S ≠ W ≠ A + P; five non-equivalent clocks; Aperture observability; Couture projection), their hostile regimes, real dials, mouse pointer probe, and source-backed synthesis and independently invented laboratories unconstrained by the existing Observatory form. Preserve each already running scientific lab. GPU effects must be mathematically constrained model visualizations rather than stock random animation or falsified epistemic surplus. Single existing Observatory animation scheduler, no perpetual background loops, no unintended change to source/author attribution, no Experiment B Flight. OPERAHOUSE ≠ OPERA ≠ PERFORMER.

operator_requirements.aesthetic: Maximum chrome-cybergoth visual risk and creative freedom: cold liquid metal, electroluminescent high-voltage arc flashes, physically suggestive caustics, refractive optics, sophisticated temporal dynamics, and radically novel mathematical GUI. Treat previous visual aesthetics as reference material, never preservation orders.
operator_requirements.technical: Invent a high-capacity extensible Observatory of mathematical laboratories with genuine runnable computational demos, physically evocative WebGL optics, independent scene controls and observable state. Every visualization tied to calculation; no unsupported scientific claims.
operator_requirements.background: The present Mugler-chromepunk frontispiece is ACCEPTABLE FOR NOW, not frozen. It and the entire design system may be sharpened, transformed, replaced or re-synthesized whenever the emergent visual mathematics warrants it. Operator explicitly grants maximal creative and operative liberty.
operator_requirements.conservation: Preserve honest source/custody attribution and research governance. Existing Observatory count, shape, modes, layout, style, controls, animation code, background, and scientific UI have NO preservation authority; the operator explicitly dislikes the current Observatory.
operator_requirements.source_rule: Do not inject unrelated Eclipse-Omega or other foreign Opera as Vixen Performer
operator_requirements.epistemic: Visual evidence of model state only, no observed physical phenomenon or human closure
operator_requirements.flight: Experiment B protected Flight HELD only as governance. Its prospective design can influence lab experiments but never lock design breadth.
operator_requirements.experimental_visual: Build and test unprecedented interactive mathematical simulations first, with full-strength rendering and distinctive chrome-optical language. Alternative rendering paths preserve access without setting the design ceiling.
operator_requirements.correction_provenance: Operator explicitly corrected the assistant's invented instruction to keep the current background intact. This commission supersedes that restriction. Creative and operative liberty is broad, user-led, and substantive.
operator_requirements.design_liberty: Maximum agent creative/operative liberty. Invent entirely new experimental labs, simulations, research instruments, choreography, workflows and optical data-language. No default four-mode ceiling, no inherited-four-mode template, no old-interface optimization. Evolve new structure from actual source mathematics, not prior UI framing.
operator_requirements.operator_correction_20261110: User explicitly rejected assistant-invented constraint to use the existing four-model Observatory; user wants a wholesale ambitious reinvention. Treat preexisting implementation as optional salvage, not baseline to be preserved.
